name: Metalcraft Gateway
description: WhatsApp / SMS via the Metalcraft Gateway (gateway.metalcraftai.com). Zero setup: because your pod already holds a Metalcraft ID token, the agent fetches its own base URL, integration ID, and webhook secret and registers its inbound webhook automatically. You only verify your phone number once. Wire-compatible with PipeStreamr under the hood.

settings.label: Persona
settings.help: The persona that answers inbound messages on this channel. Leave blank to use the orchestrator-agent.

settings.label: Model
settings.help: Model the persona runs with. Leave blank for the daemon default.
